There are 3 switches outside a closed room, each connected to one of 3 identical light bulbs inside. You may operate the switches however you like, but can enter the room to look at the bulbs only once. How can you determine with certainty which switch controls which bulb?
choices: Flip each switch on and off once in sequence, then enter and guess based on which bulb seems brightest
Turn switch 1 on for several minutes, then turn it off and turn switch 2 on; enter — the lit bulb is switch 2, the warm-but-dark bulb is switch 1, and the cold dark bulb is switch 3
It cannot be done with only one entry into the room
Turn all three switches on at once, then enter and see which bulbs are lit
